FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF APPLIED SCIENCES
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGENEERING & TECHNOLOGY (U.I.E.T)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160014, INDIA
Advertisement for the walk-in interview for the appointment of
Project Assistant
Candidates are invited for walk-in-interview on 19.11.2024 at 10:00 AM in the office of the
Director of University Institute of Engineering & Technology (U.I.E.T) for the position of
Project Assistant (PA) in the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) sponsored research project
entitled “Self-assembled tyrosine microstructures in PVA film as potential alternative to
single use plastic” sanctioned to the undersigned. Interested candidates may bring attested
copies of certificates, work experience and any other relevant certificates at the time of walk-
in-interview.
Essential Qualifications:
1. M.Sc. Degree in Chemistry/ Organic Chemistry with at least 60% marks.
2. Experience in self-assembly related research work.
Salary: The selected candidate will be paid salary of INR 20,000 pm + HRA as per the DBT
rules.
Duration: The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project.
Note: No TA / DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Dr. Nishima
(Principal Investigator)
University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Sector-25, Panjab University,
Chandigarh-160014
Email: nishima@pu.ac.in
